1.en: By the dawn that is to say by the dawn of each day

2.en: and by the ten nights the first ten nights of Dhū’l-Hijja

3.en: and by the even the pair and the odd read watr or witr two alternative forms the single
3.ar: ﴿والشَّفْع﴾ الزَّوْج ﴿والوَتْر﴾ بِفَتْحِ الواو وكَسْرها لُغَتانِ: الفَرْد

4.en: and by the night in motion falling or receding

5.en: Is there in that oath an oath for one of sense? one of intellect the response to the oath has been omitted that is to say it is to be understood as something like la-tu‘adhdhabunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you will assuredly be chastised O disbelievers of Mecca!’.
5.ar: ﴿هَلْ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ القَسَم ﴿قَسَم لِذِي حِجْر﴾ عَقْل، وجَواب القَسَم مَحْذُوف أيْ: لَتُعَذَّبُنَّ يا كُفّار مَكَّة

6.en: Have you not seen do you not know O Muhammad (s) how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād
6.ar: ﴿ألَمْ تَرى﴾ تَعْلَم يا مُحَمَّد ﴿كَيْف فَعَلَ رَبّك بِعادٍ﴾

7.en: Iram — these were the former people of ‘Ād Irama is an explicative supplement or a substitution and it is treated as a diptote because it is a proper noun and feminine — of the towering ones that is to say the tall ones — the tallest one among them would reach four hundred cubits —
7.ar: ﴿إرَم﴾ هِيَ عاد الأُولى، فَإرَم عَطْف بَيان أوْ بَدَل، ومَنع الصَّرْف لِلْعَلَمِيَّةِ والتَّأْنِيث ﴿ذات العِماد﴾ أيْ الطُّول كانَ طُول الطَّوِيل مِنهُمْ أرْبَعمِائَةِ ذِراع

8.en: the like of which was not created in the land in terms of their power of assault and strength
8.ar: ﴿الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَق مِثْلها فِي البِلاد﴾ فِي بَطْشهمْ وقُوَّتهمْ

9.en: and Thamūd who hollowed hewed the rocks sakhr is the plural of sakhra in the valley the Wādī al-Qurā rocks which they used as dwellings
9.ar: ﴿وثَمُود الَّذِينَ جابُوا﴾ قَطَعُوا ﴿الصَّخْر﴾ جَمْع صَخْرَة واِتَّخَذُوها بُيُوتًا ﴿بِالوادِ﴾ وادِي القُرى

10.en: and Pharaoh the one of the tent-pegs he used to fasten four pegs and tie to these the hands and feet of those whom he tortured —
10.ar: ﴿وفِرْعَوْن ذِي الأَوْتاد﴾ كانَ يَتِد أرْبَعَة أوْتاد يَشُدّ إلَيْها يَدَيْ ورِجْلَيْ مَن يُعَذِّبهُ

11.en: those who were rebellious became tyrannical in the land

12.en: and caused much corruption therein? by way of slaying and otherwise.

13.en: So your Lord poured on them a scourge of chastisement.

14.en: Assuredly your Lord is ever on the watch watching over the deeds of servants nothing of which escapes Him that He may then requite them for these deeds.
14.ar: ﴿إنَّ رَبّك لَبِالمِرْصادِ﴾ يَرْصُد أعْمال العِباد فَلا يَفُوتهُ مِنها شَيْء لِيُجازِيَهُمْ عَلَيْها

15.en: And as for man the disbeliever whenever his Lord tests him and honours him with wealth and other things and is gracious to him he says ‘My Lord has honoured me’.
15.ar: ﴿فَأَمّا الإنْسان﴾ الكافِر ﴿إذا ما اِبْتَلاهُ﴾ اِخْتَبَرَهُ ﴿رَبّه فَأَكْرَمَهُ﴾ بِالمالِ وغَيْره ﴿ونَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُول رَبِّي أكْرَمْنَ﴾

16.en: But when he tests him and restricts his provision for him he says ‘My Lord has humiliated me’.
16.ar: ﴿وأَمّا إذا ما اِبْتَلاهُ فَقَدَرَ﴾ ضَيَّقَ ﴿عَلَيْهِ رِزْقه فَيَقُول رَبِّي أهانَن﴾

17.en: No indeed! — a disavowal of this notion in other words honour is not about wealth nor is there any humiliation in poverty rather it has to do with obedience and disobedience respectively; but the disbelievers of Mecca unmindful of this. Rather they do not honour the orphan they do not treat him with kindness despite their wealth or it means that they do not give him what is his due from an inheritance
17.ar: ﴿كَلّا﴾ رَدْع، أيْ لَيْسَ الإكْرام بِالغِنى والإهانَة بِالفَقْرِ وإنَّما هُوَ بِالطّاعَةِ والمَعْصِيَة، وكُفّار مَكَّة لا يَنْتَبِهُونَ لِذَلِكَ ﴿بَلْ لا تُكْرِمُونَ اليَتِيم﴾ لا يُحْسِنُونَ إلَيْهِ مَعَ غِناهُمْ أوْ لا يُعْطُونَهُ حَقّه مِن المِيراث

18.en: and they do not urge neither themselves nor others the feeding of the needy;
18.ar: ﴿ولا تَحاضُّونَ﴾ أنْفُسهمْ أوْ غَيْرهمْ ﴿عَلى طَعام﴾ أيْ إطْعام ﴿المِسْكِين﴾

19.en: and they devour inheritance turāth means mīrāth greedily lamman that is to say voraciously when they appropriate lammuhum the women’s and the young ones’ share of the inheritance together with their own share of it or to their own wealth;
19.ar: ﴿وتَأْكُلُونَ التُّراث﴾ المِيراث ﴿أكْلًا لَمًّا﴾ أيْ شَدِيدًا، لِلَمِّهِمْ نَصِيب النِّساء والصِّبْيان مِن المِيراث مَعَ نَصِيبهمْ مِنهُ أوْ مَعَ مالهمْ

20.en: and they love wealth with abounding love that is to say greatly and so they do not expend any of it a variant reading in the case of all four verbs has the second person plural.
20.ar: ﴿وتُحِبُّونَ المال حُبًّا جَمًّا﴾ أيْ: كَثِيرًا فَلا يُنْفِقُونَهُ، وفِي قِراءَة بِالفَوْقانِيَّةِ فِي الأَفْعال الأَرْبَعَة

21.en: No indeed! — a deterrent for them from such conduct. When the earth is pulverised repeatedly when it is shaken until every edifice has collapsed and is destroyed
21.ar: ﴿كَلّا﴾ رَدْع لَهُمْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ﴿إذا دُكَّتْ الأَرْض دَكًّا دَكًّا﴾ زُلْزِلَتْ حَتّى يَنْهَدِم كُلّ بِناء عَلَيْها ويَنْعَدِم

22.en: and your Lord that is to say His command and the angels arrive rank on rank saffan saffan is a circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘standing in rows’ or ‘made up of many ranks’
22.ar: ﴿وجاءَ رَبّك﴾ أيْ أمْره ﴿والمَلَك﴾ أيْ المَلائِكَة ﴿صَفًّا صَفًّا﴾ حال، أيْ مُصْطَفِّينَ أوْ ذَوِي صُفُوف كَثِيرَة

23.en: and Hell on that day is brought near pulled by seventy thousand sets of reins each set of reins pulled by the hands of seventy thousand angels as it groans and seethes in fury; on that day yawma’idhin is a substitution for idhā ‘when’ the response to which is the following man that is to say the disbeliever will remember his prodigal conduct in it but how will remembering avail him now? the interrogative is meant as a denial in other words his remembering that will not be of any use to him.
23.ar: ﴿وجِيءَ يَوْمئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّم﴾ تُقاد بِسَبْعِينَ ألْف زِمام كُلّ زِمام بِأَيْدِي سَبْعِينَ ألْف مَلَك لَها زَفِير وتَغَيُّظ ﴿يَوْمئِذٍ﴾ بَدَل مِن إذا وجَوابها ﴿يَتَذَكَّر الإنْسان﴾ أيْ الكافِر ما فَرَّطَ فِيهِ ﴿وأَنّى لَهُ الذِّكْرى﴾ اِسْتِفْهام بِمَعْنى النَّفْي، أيْ لا يَنْفَعهُ تَذَكُّره ذَلِكَ

24.en: He will say as he remembers ‘O yā is for calling attention to something would that I had sent ahead good deeds and faith for my life!’ for a good life in the Hereafter or it means ‘during my life’ in the world.
24.ar: ﴿يَقُول﴾ مَعَ تَذَكُّره ﴿يا لَيْتَنِي﴾ لِلتَّنْبِيهِ ﴿قَدَّمْت﴾ الخَيْر والإيمان ﴿لِحَياتِي﴾ الطَّيِّبَة فِي الآخِرَة أوْ وقْت حَياتِي فِي الدُّنْيا

25.en: Then on that day none shall mete out read yu‘adhdhibu His God’s chastisement that is to say He shall not delegate it to any other;
25.ar: ﴿فَيَوْمئِذٍ لا يُعَذِّب﴾ بِكَسْرِ الذّال ﴿عَذابه﴾ أيْ اللَّه ﴿أحَد﴾ أيْ لا يَكِلهُ إلى غَيْره

26.en: and likewise none shall bind read yūthiqu His bind a variant reading has yu‘adhdhabu ‘none shall be chastised’ and yūthaqu ‘none shall be bound’ so that the suffixed pronoun of ‘adhābahu and wathāqahu refers to the chastisement and the binds of the disbeliever the meaning then being ‘none shall be chastised as he shall and none shall be bound as he shall be bound’.
26.ar: ﴿ولا يُوثِق﴾ وكَذا " لا يُوثِق " بِكَسْرِ الثّاء ﴿وثاقه أحَد﴾ وفِي قِراءَة بِفَتْحِ الذّال والثّاء فَضَمِير عَذابه ووَثاقه لِلْكافِرِ والمَعْنى لا يُعَذَّب أحَد مِثْل تَعْذِيبه ولا يُوثَق مِثْل إيثاقه

27.en: ‘O soul at peace! the one secure namely the believing one.
27.ar: ﴿يا أيَّتها النَّفْس المُطَمْئِنَة﴾ الآمِنَة وهِيَ المُؤْمِنَة

28.en: Return — this is said to it upon death — to your Lord that is to say return to His command and to His will pleased with the reward pleasing in God’s sight with your deeds; in other words return O soul combining both descriptions both of which are circumstantial qualifiers. And it will be said to it at the Resurrection
28.ar: ﴿اِرْجِعِي إلى رَبّك﴾ يُقال لَها ذَلِكَ عِنْد المَوْت، أيْ اِرْجِعِي إلى أمْره وإرادَته ﴿راضِيَة﴾ بِالثَّوابِ ﴿مَرْضِيَّة﴾ عِنْد اللَّه بِعَمَلِك، أيْ جامِعَة بَيْن الوَصْفَيْنِ وهُما حالانِ ويُقال لَها فِي القِيامَة

29.en: Then enter among My righteous servants!

30.en: And enter My Paradise!’ with them.
